title: Component gallery cleanup - drop dead cards, fix the slider entry, add the settings switch
description: Delete MpiProjectCard (dead component, only the gallery mounts it). Drop the MpiPromptBox, MpiProjectName and MpiVoicePicker cards from the gallery. Rehome the two slider cards: they are labelled MpiSlider, a component that has not existed since it was absorbed into MpiProgressBar, and they sit in Compounds while MpiProgressBar is a Primitive. Add the switch variant of MpiCheckbox (the Settings toggle) to the gallery.
